newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Petro to net HK$333 mln in issue.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Petro to net HK$333 mln in issue.

text.p: Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd said on Monday it would issue and place 150 million new H-shares at HK$2.28 each to raise about HK$333.4 million after expenses.
Proceeds from the placement will be used to finance, in part, the company's capital expansion programme and to provide for working capital, Shanghai Petro said in a statement.
Market sources earlier said the company would raise a gross HK$342 million, and that the response to the placement was good and allocation underway.
The new H-shares are being placed with non-U.S. persons on a fully underwritten basis and would represent about 2.08 percent of the post-placement share capital, the company said.
Completion of the placement is conditional on the shares being approved for listing in Hong Kong by January 20.
H-shares are Hong Kong-listed shares in China-incorporated companies.
